narr: Scattered thunderstorms developed during the afternoon of the 7th ahead of a cold front across northern Oklahoma, with storms repeatedly training over portions of the Enid area. Reports of flash flooding were received with these storms.
ev: Six water rescues within Enid. 8 to 10 feet of water below one underpass.
Numerous roads covered in water. 4 to 6 inches of flowing water observed on some.
